acceptance_law: Materialize and freeze a task-level 256-item adversarial battery before scoring substitutions.
Score baseline and every proposed swap against the identical frozen battery.
A swap may be accepted only if direct natural-expression coverage improves and practical completion remains at or above 98 percent.
No accepted swap may create a new safety-critical failure.
After each accepted swap, rerun uniqueness and morphological-normalization checks.
Only a separately admitted canonical mutation may edit vocabulary-band authorities.
